format: Traditional Facility (freestanding BURGER KING Restaurant), excluding real estate

invest.quote: Traditional Facility ... Total Estimated Initial Investment 18 $2,039,200 $4,730,600 (cover: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a BURGER KING® Restaurant (“Restaurant”) is between $348,400 and $4,730,600, in all cases excluding real estate. This includes $57,750 to $62,500 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliates.)

fee.quote: The standard franchise fee for a 20-year Franchise Agreement term (including successor Franchise Agreements) is $50,000.
fee.note: Prorated for shorter terms, minimum currently $15,000 (typically $25,000 for a 10-year term, non-traditional sites). Plus application fee $250 per individual applicant and $5,000 for entity ownership, and $7,500 New Franchisee Training Fee per trainee. Development Agreement: prepay $50,000 per Restaurant (minimum $100,000). TRA/MTRA deposits credited against the fee.

royalty.quote: Royalty2 4.5% of monthly Gross Sales2 Payable monthly on 10th day of next month

adFund.quote: Advertising3 An amount not to exceed 4.5% of monthly Gross Sales3 ... As of January 1, 2025 the advertising contribution is 4.5% of Gross Sales
adFund.note: Advertising contribution currently 4.5%, capped at 4.5%. Investment Spending (marketing): up to 2.0% of Gross Sales, amount determined collectively by franchisees in the DMA. Reduced rates under the 2024 Multi-Unit New Development program (royalty 2.5%-4.5%, advertising 2.0%-3.5% in years 1-5).

otherRecurring.name: Digital Services Fee
otherRecurring.amount: $110 per Restaurant per month, plus 1% of monthly digital sales; not to exceed $4,500 per Restaurant per year

otherRecurring.name: Burger King Foundation
otherRecurring.amount: $1,000 per Restaurant per year (purchase or fundraise in-restaurant)

otherRecurring.name: Gift Card Services
otherRecurring.amount: Set-up fee: $40 per Restaurant; Transaction Fee: Estimated 1.8% of any redeemed sales

otherRecurring.name: Static Menu Board Kit
otherRecurring.amount: $200 to $300 per month (only if no outdoor digital menu board installed)

transferFee.amount: $2,000 for the first Restaurant and $500 for each additional Restaurant transferred in the same transaction. $175 additional transfer fee per restaurant for transfers occurring on the weekend and on United States federal holidays

rentToFranchisor: Only where the premises are leased from BKC (BKL/BKG): minimum annual rent typically 10% of capitalized site acquisition and construction costs (or 125% of BKC's rent plus 10% of costs), plus percentage rent which is typically 8.5% of monthly Gross Sales up to $133,333.33 and increases to 10% on monthly Gross Sales above $133,333.33 per month in excess of the monthly installment of the guaranteed minimum annual rent.

special: Investment excludes real estate (Item 7 note 3: buying unimproved land for a freestanding facility may cost $250,000 to $2,000,000). If BKC is the landlord, percentage rent is typically 8.5% of monthly Gross Sales (10% above $133,333.33/month) on top of royalty and advertising. Remodel deadlines missed under Reclaim the Flame 2 / Sizzle Jr. programs raise royalty by 3.0%; deferred remodel default royalty 6.0% or 7.5%. 2024 Carrols acquisition turned 1,023 franchised Restaurants into company-owned.
issues: toFranchisor $57,750-$62,500 is the cover figure for all formats, not specific to the Traditional Facility. Cover investment range $348,400-$4,730,600 spans all formats; the Traditional low $2,039,200 is used.
